headline: Instagram now lets you fix a Story after posting
dek: You can edit a published Story for up to 15 minutes, along with easier multi-image posts and new holiday stickers.
why: Small teams posting quick promos can fix a wrong date, price or link without deleting the Story and losing its views.
doThis: Typo in a holiday promo? Edit it within 15 minutes instead of deleting it and losing your views.
